selection_rule: freeze: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows (components excluded); ties by creation tick then id; cohort_best (created by the cohort), accessible_best (created by the cohort or visible earlier cohorts), held_best (held by the cohort's members)

P.primary: final-freeze held_best: validation score and sealed-2 score, beam vs first-improvement, paired by seed within each access condition
secondary: beam vs beam-nocomponents (language capability, preserved access)
P.claim_rule: a direction is reported as consistent only if it holds in at least 4 of 5 paired seeds; otherwise 'no consistent difference'. No significance test is claimed with 5 seeds.

primary: final-freeze held_best sealed-2 score by condition
T.further_improvement: cohort k's own best admitted workflow strictly better (validation) than the best workflow cohort k-1's members held at their freeze
T.claim_rule: same 4-of-5 rule; teaching-only vs none is the teaching contrast, library vs none the library contrast

experiments.direct_transfer_diagnostic: not run in this milestone (optional in the specification)

no_tuning_after_freeze: settings, policies and seeds above are fixed; sealed scores are computed only after every run is closed
